title: Shatter
description: A record cover printed on a thick pane of glass. Tap it and the glass cracks out from your finger in rings and rays, each shard bending the picture a little differently; drag through the cracks and the shards fall, tumble and chime onto the floor, opening a window onto the next cover behind.
intent: Factory round 1. Material: glass. Verb: break. Destruction that reveals the next record.
